# Fixed Draco runtime

These are the unchanged Draco 1.5.5 browser decoders, matched byte-for-byte to
google/draco commit a5b31570c3204326e80c0d0d9d4434f0a10dc71b, javascript/.
The full upstream license and appendix are in 1.5.5/LICENSE.txt.

Acquisition: https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.5/
Evidence: licenses/runtime-notice-evidence.json and docs/runtime-asset-notices.md.
apps/web/runtime-assets.mjs verifies fixed SHA256 values before serving/emitting.
Do not format, upgrade, or substitute these files without a new provenance review.

Local technical validation is not approval of the application's full distribution.
